# MDL007: mdl-version

| Field | Value |
|---|---|

Missing version header, unsupported major, or files of one model with different majors.

A file with a missing or unsupported header is refused whole and never parsed on a guess.

## Examples

### MDL007 version header / An unsupported major fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "3";
module m;
```

### MDL007 version header / A supported header is clean #2 (line 13) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
```
